title: WordPress Core: attackers can run their own code
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 46 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. Ready-made attack tools are public. The exploit prediction score is 96%.

category.label: Website or online store
category.why: It runs public websites, online stores or the software behind them.
category.doThis: Ask whoever runs your website or store to update it.

summary: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 28, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
